title: Complete Consolidated Border and In-Content Chips in LaTeX Templates
description: The semio design system was changed to consolidated border with in-content chips from the out-content chips with separate elements. The latex templates are not correctly reflecting this. Complete the design system also on latex.
summary:
Every horizontal edge is now neutral; only vertical edges may carry an accent.

- **Frame primitives:** the open, close and record primitives no longer carry a colour, so no accent passes from one frame to the next.
- **Section edges:** the heading top edge, the window top edge and the long-table top edge are drawn in the neutral border colour.
- **Chips:** their top and bottom edges are neutral, and their side edges keep the ladder colour.
- **Unchanged from earlier rounds:** shared borders, the closed text column, in-content chips, lists split into cells, and the long table that stays open at a page break.

The colour audit (`edge-colors.py`) finds no non-neutral frame or chip edge in the junction and chapter fixtures, the report (light and dark), the thesis, or the energy and parametrization assignments. All of them rebuilt without errors.

The frame junction test (with the new edge colour rule), the page chrome test, the quick pipeline verification and the assignment test (20 of 20) pass when run directly with bun. The `repo` targets still fail in `repo`'s build graph.

See summary.md.

Verified on junction fixtures (edges coincide within 0.01 pt), report, thesis, flyer and the energy assignment; paper, phd and Zukunft Bau produce no PDF in the local harness (also with unmodified packages for paper) and were not checked. See summary.md.
